title: C: Reference Counting
description: Implement a simple reference-counted pointer to automatically manage memory.

steps.title: RefCounted Pointer
steps.description: Define a `RefCounted` struct containing a pointer and a reference count pointer. Write `void* rc_new(int size)` that allocates memory with a refcount of 1. Write `void* rc_ref(void *ptr)` that increments the refcount. Write `void rc_unref(void *ptr)` that decrements and frees when 0.
hints: Store refcount just before the data pointer.
Allocate: refcount + data in one malloc.

verification.failureMessage: Create, reference, and unreference to see refcounts
